title: Evaluating the Effect of the Order of Optimization Passes in Quantum Circuit Optimization
summary: Quantum circuit optimization is critical for mitigating the noise inherent in current quantum hardware. Quantum compilers typically sequentially apply multiple optimizations (also called ``optimization passes'') to improve the circuit. The impact of the order in which these passes are executed has yet been largely unexplored.
